text:
maria: Heads up team — planning a "live-fire" red-team run for Friday 2024-06-21. Scope: auth svc, model inference tier, and telemetry plumbing. We need a clear triage + retest cadence. Who owns the triage board?
tony: I can take triage ownership. Proposed rules: label sev/critical -> must be fixed before retest; sev/high -> preferred fix before retest, otherwise documented mitigation + compensating control; sev/medium/low -> scheduled in next sprint. I'll create a remediation tracker with columns: ticket, owner, status, evidence-link, verification-owner.
sam: From infra side: we'll enable an assessor-only subnet with no egress except to the KMS-proxy and S3 for evidence uploads. No cross-account decrypts allowed. If assessors need a decrypt, they call sec-ops and we perform a recorded, one-off operation.
maria: Good. For KMS: Olivia was busy last week so propose this pattern: key policy allows DescribeKey + Encrypt to assessor role but decrypt only via a proxy service in our control plane that performs decrypts inside an HSM-backed function and returns an audit-hash. The assessor gets only the plaintext if absolutely necessary and only via a recorded session.
ton y: (typo) re: evidence — require an evidence bundle in S3 under prefix assessments/livefire-<ts>/ with manifest.csv including SHA256, sanitized flag, and a link to the RBAC snapshot. Also require CloudTrail export hash (sha256) for the window.
sec-bot: [automated] Created ticket SEC-9123: "Live-fire redteam intake & retest cadence" https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SEC-9123
eng-oncall: I'll schedule the infra canary at 08:00 PT the day of. Canary steps: snapshot SGs, snapshot IAM policies (iam get-account-authorization-details), apply assessor-only SGs, mirror CloudTrail -> s3://assessments-livefire-1744500000/, and enable object lock disabled for packaging. Rolling rollback script will be ready.
maria: Minimal IAM snippet for assessor role session policy (will paste in ticket):
```json
{ "Version":"2012-10-17", "Statement":[{ "Effect":"Allow", "Action":["s3:PutObject","s3:ListBucket"], "Resource":"arn:aws:s3:::assessments-livefire-1744500000/*" },{ "Effect":"Allow", "Action":["kms:DescribeKey"], "Resource":"arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/alias/livefire-proxy" } ] }
```
tony: Great. Retest gating (my proposal): 1) No open criticals. 2) All open highs have documented mitigation + scheduled fix or verified hotfix. 3) Evidence bundle + RBAC snapshot + CloudTrail export hash present in ticket. 4) Verification owner assigned and has signed off. If gating fails, retest delayed by 48h and we run root-cause retro.
sam: Also add a safety corridor: if during retest we hit production-impacting exploit, eng-oncall triggers the kill-switch (isolate assessor subnet + revoke assessor roles) and we enter incident mode. We should rehearse this in a tabletop.
maria: Action items: tony -> create remediation tracker + labels (retest-required, evidence-ready). sam -> prepare assessor subnet + canary runbook. eng-oncall -> S3 mirror + rollback script. I'll own assessor coordination and evidence acceptance.
ton y: I'll include a csv export for triage and a quick viz (status by severity). Will link to SEC-9123 and post updates hourly during ops.
sec-bot: [automated] SEC-9123 updated: assignees set to tony, sam, maria, eng-oncall. Due date 2024-06-20.
maria: Final note — scrub PII before any uploads. If assessors request data samples, provide synthetic or redacted copies. We'll reconvene 24h before for go/no-go. :white_check_mark:
